description: This bar chart illustrates the GLUE performance of different fine-tuning methods applied to RoBERTa models of varying sizes. The horizontal axis represents the fine-tuning method, with categories labeled “Prefix,” “Adaptor,” “LoRA,” “BitFit,” “S₁-model,” “S₄-model,” and “S₅-model,” displayed in that order. The vertical axis is labeled “GLUE Performance” and represents a linear scale ranging from approximately 84 to 89, with tick labels displayed at intervals of 2. Each fine-tuning method is represented by two bars displayed side-by-side: a blue bar representing “base” RoBERTa size and an orange bar representing “large” RoBERTa size, as indicated by the legend. For the “Prefix” method, the “base” bar reaches approximately 85.3, whereas the “large” bar reaches approximately 87.3, and for the “S₅-model” method, the “base” bar reaches approximately 86.7, and the “large” bar reaches approximately 88.7. The bars are not sorted and no bars are visually emphasized.
